text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro position and thesis in opening paragraph","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states a definite position early and explains the main reasons it will defend."},{"evidence":"multiple body paragraphs with topic sentences","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is arranged into distinct sections that make the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"explains benefits and counterarguments before answering them","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay does more than state a claim by developing reasons, acknowledging objections, and responding to them."},{"evidence":"uses article details like fuel use, roadblocks, and liability","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay draws on several specific details from the source to support its points."},{"evidence":"offers a possible programmable driveway solution","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay adds original reasoning and examples that extend beyond simple restatement of the article."},{"evidence":"concluding paragraph restates the argument and future outlook","quality":"conclusion strength","description":"The essay ends by tying together the main reasons and reinforcing the overall stance."}]}
